name: Lencia Fullcity
original_name: レンシア・フルシティ
source:
Occupation: Florist
Hobbies: Watering Flowers

She is the protagonist's cousin and childhood friend. Works part-time every day at a street stall selling flowers, but dreams of one day owning her own shop.

She affectionately calls the protagonist "big brother."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041102071829fw_/http://www.studio-ego.co.jp/030/ego/game/maw/lencia.html]Studio e.go![/url]]
